article.summary_es: Hope Center Development Corporation es un comedor y despensa de alimentos en Brooklyn, Nueva York, que aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
article.summary_en: Hope Center Development Corporation is a soup kitchen and food pantry in Brooklyn, New York, listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
how_they_help_es: Es un comedor de sopa y despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC.
Está ubicado en 409 E 95th St, Brooklyn, NY 11212.
El comedor solo abre el 1er, 2do, 3er y 4to sábado del mes.
Qué alimentos entrega y si hay requisitos no están indicados; pregunte por teléfono.
how_they_help_en: It is a soup kitchen and food pantry according to the Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 409 E 95th St, Brooklyn, NY 11212.
It is open Saturdays from 11am to 1:30pm.
The soup kitchen is only open the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Saturday of the month.
What food is given and any requirements are not listed; ask by phone.
